notes.title: Regular Update v1.08: New X-Ray Gameplay, Characters, Bug Fixes & More!
notes.notes:
Regular Update v1.08: New X-Ray Gameplay, Characters, Bug Fixes & More!


Dear Doctors,

This update brings a major step forward for Doctor Life Simulator, with deeper gameplay systems, visual upgrades, interface improvements, and fresh content to explore. From immersive X-Ray scanning to a refined decision-making system, Version 8 sets the stage for what’s coming next  and it’s only the beginning.


What is new at Version 8?

Enhanced Decision-Making System
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444963/6f8aa745cfc30fc5f47d785e7be41011eb772e71.gif"]

In this update, we've improved how your choices shape the life of your doctor. Every decision, from diagnosis and treatment to ethical dilemmas and personal development, now has deeper consequences and branching outcomes.

Dynamic Outcomes: Your decisions now influence patient satisfaction, hospital reputation, and your story.

Ethical Scenarios: You'll face tougher moral choices with no obvious right answer. Will you put the patient first, protect the hospital, or look out for yourself?

Replayability Boost: Key events now have multiple outcomes, making each playthrough feel unique based on the choices you make.


New X-Ray Gameplay[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444963/63a56877d730c7588a5e8c3da2ca340ca28fad28.gif"]
Say hello to a brand-new interactive X-Ray scanning system! Designed to bring more immersion and precision to your diagnostic process, this feature puts you directly in control.

Adjustable Parameters: Fine-tune Power, Exposure, Zoom, and Position to get the clearest image. Use the interface to locate fractures, tumors, or foreign objects in real time.

Interactive Feedback: You'll see the scan dynamically update as you adjust the sliders. The better your scan quality, the more accurate your diagnosis.

Skill-Based Imaging: Successful scans now depend on your attention and technical skills. Learn to master the tool or risk misdiagnosing your patients.
New Characters & Character Graphics Overhaul
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444963/c05ecffad09d2a53b03174c75e1025735b94f688.gif"]

Your hospital just got a lot more lively. We've introduced new faces and upgraded the look of existing ones to bring more personality and realism to your world.

New Staff & Patients: Meet fresh characters with unique backgrounds, appearances, and dialogue. From quirky interns to demanding specialists, every new addition brings variety to your day-to-day interactions.

Graphics Refresh: Existing characters have received a visual upgrade. Improved models, more expressive animations, and refined textures make interactions feel more human and immersive.

Diversity Boost: Expect a wider range of styles, ages, and looks among both staff and patients, helping to reflect a more authentic hospital environment.


Version 1.08 Changelog
Gameplay Features

Enhanced Decision-Making System

New X-Ray Gameplay

Car Gameplay is Now Optional

Game Economy Updated

8 New Characters

Visual and Audio Enhancements

Lighting Improvements

New Music Tracks

Main Menu Background Changed

Improved Player Camera and Movement

Car Camera Angle Changed

User Interface Updates

New Furnitures UI

New Upgrades UI

NPC Mini-Avatars for Diagnosis Section Implemented

Added More Resolution Options

Localization Updates

Other

Harlequin removed


What’s Next?
We’re just getting started. Here’s a preview of what’s coming in future updates:

Hospital Editor: Design and customize your own hospital layout. Build, expand, and organize departments exactly how you want.

Narrative-Driven Emergency Missions: Head into Brightwater City to take on high-stakes, story-rich emergency scenarios where your decisions can save lives.

Surgery Update: A full overhaul of the surgery system is on the way, featuring new procedures, tools, and interactive mechanics.

Co-op Gameplay: Work together with friends to run a hospital. Share responsibilities, coordinate care, and handle complex cases as a team.

Mod Support: Create and share your own content, from custom characters to entire storylines, using upcoming modding tools.


Our aim is to bring real medical gameplay to life.. with our community.Don't forget to join our discord, we listen to your ideas and feedback.Thank you for supporting us, doctors...

-Blackburne Games Team

notes.title: Day 4 Update - Bugfix
notes.notes:
📢 Doctor Life Simulator - Bugfix!

Hello, Doctors!  

We’ve rolled out an exciting update for Doctor Life Simulator, featuring gameplay enhancements, new features, and bug fixes. Your feedback has been invaluable—thank you for helping us improve the game!  



Gameplay Updates  
- Fixed and improved ambulance gameplay mechanics.  
- Car and house level updates for a smoother experience.  
- Refined level end UI and gameplay flow for a more rewarding conclusion.  
- New endings added for a richer story experience!  



Audio and Visual Enhancements  
- Fixed issues with master volume and menu music/mute toggles.  
- Added motion blur settings and other graphic options for better customization.  
- New music tracks to elevate the atmosphere.  


UI & System Improvements  
- Updated menu hover fonts for better readability.  
- Introduced a new staff hiring UI to streamline team management.  
- Enhanced home laptop functionality for in-game interactions.  
- Fixed language toggle and added localizations for a global experience.  



Additional Fixes  
- Adjusted Stateschopu mechanic for improved balance.  
- Improved money and reputation tracking for better progression clarity.  


Coming Soon: New Content!  
This week, we’re bringing exciting new additions to Doctor Life Simulator:  
- New patients with unique cases and challenges.  
- Furniture upgrades to customize your clinic.  
- Clinic upgrades to enhance gameplay and functionality.  



We’re dedicated to making Doctor Life Simulator the best it can be, and we hope you enjoy these updates. Don’t forget to share your thoughts—we’d love to hear from you!  

Update your game now and get ready for the upcoming content!

notes.title: Early Access release date to May 30, 2025
notes.notes:
We know we’ve kept you waiting, and we sincerely apologize for the two delays. But this was the reason: we wanted to make the experience accessible and meaningful for more people around the world.

We’re incredibly excited to share some big news with you!

To make Doctor Life Simulator accessible to a wider global audience, we’ve added full language support in the following languages:

🇬🇧 English
🇨🇳 Chinese
🇫🇷 French
🇩🇪 German
🇪🇸 Spanish
🇮🇹 Italian
🇯🇵 Japanese
🇰🇷 Korean
🇷🇺 Russian
🇹🇷 Turkish
🇬🇷 Greek
🇬🇪 Georgian

We’re also thrilled to announce that Doctor Life Simulator now features full Turkish voice-over! 🎙️🇹🇷

To ensure everything is polished and localized properly for all players, we’ve made the decision to move the Early Access release date to May 30, 2025.

We know delays are never easy, but we believe this short wait will help us deliver a better and more inclusive experience for everyone. Thank you for your support and patience!

See you soon in the hospital corridors!

Dear Players,

We want to address an important issue with the demo for Doctor Life Simulator. Due to an error on Valve's end during the Steam upload process, an outdated version of the game was mistakenly made available for Next Fest for 1 day.  We sincerely apologize for the confusion and inconvenience this caused.

The good news is that the updated and correct version of the Next Fest demo is now live! 🎉 This update includes all the latest fixes, features, and improvements we’ve been working on to deliver the best experience possible.

We appreciate your patience and understanding as we worked with Valve to resolve this issue. Your feedback is invaluable, so please let us know your thoughts on the updated demo!

Thank you for being part of the journey with Doctor Life Simulator. We can’t wait to hear what you think.

Stay tuned for more updates, and see you in the game!

-Blackburne Games Team
